question: What is the function of Ctrl + X in the active workbook?
options: Cuts the current selection to the clipboard
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Ctrl + X is used to cut the current selection to the clipboard.

question: Which shortcut key is used to repeat the last workbook action?
explanation: Ctrl + Y is used to repeat (redo) the last workbook action.

question: What is the function of Shift + Enter in the active cell?
options: Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves one cell to the right
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves one cell to the left
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Shift + Enter enters the contents of the active cell and moves selection to the cell above.

question: Which shortcut key is used to enter the SUM() function?
explanation: Alt + = automatically inserts the AutoSum formula.

question: What is the function of Ctrl + ' in the active cell?
options: Enters the contents from the cell directly above into the active cell
Enters the current date into the active cell
Enters the current time into the active cell
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Ctrl + ' copies the formula or value from the cell directly above the active cell.

question: Which shortcut key is used to enter the current date into the active cell?
explanation: Ctrl + ; inserts the current system date into the active cell.

question: What is the function of Ctrl + Shift + ; in the active cell?
options: Enters the current date into the active cell
Enters the current time into the active cell
Enters the contents from the cell directly above into the active cell
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Ctrl + Shift + ; inserts the current system time into the active cell.

question: Which shortcut key is used to enter the formula as an Array Formula?
explanation: Ctrl + Shift + Enter enters a formula as a legacy Array Formula.

question: What is the function of Shift + Insert in the active cell?
options: Enters the data from the clipboard
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
explanation: Shift + Insert pastes data from the clipboard.

question: Which shortcut key is used to display the Pick From List drop-down list?
explanation: Alt + Down Arrow displays the Pick From List drop-down menu in Excel.

question: What is the function of Esc in the active cell?
options: Cancels the cell entry and restores the original contents
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
explanation: Esc cancels an entry in the cell or formula bar.

question: Which shortcut key is used to delete the selection or one character to the right?
explanation: Delete clears cell contents or deletes characters to the right of the cursor.

question: What is the function of Backspace in the active cell?
options: Deletes the selection or one character to the right
Deletes the selection or one character to the left
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
explanation: Backspace clears the active cell or deletes characters to the left of the cursor.

question: Which shortcut key is used to cut the selection to the clipboard?
explanation: Ctrl + X cuts the selected cells or text.

question: What is the function of Ctrl + Delete in the active cell?
options: Deletes text to the end of the line
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
explanation: Ctrl + Delete deletes text from the cursor position to the end of the line.

question: Which shortcut key is used to display the Delete dialog box?
explanation: Ctrl + - displays the Delete dialog box to delete selected cells, rows, or columns.

question: What is the function of Ctrl + Shift + = in the active cell?
options: Displays the Insert dialog box to insert blank cells
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Ctrl + Shift + = displays the Insert dialog box to insert new cells, rows, or columns.

question: Which shortcut key is used to enter a new line into a cell?
explanation: Alt + Enter starts a new line within the same cell.

question: What is the function of Tab in the active cell?
options: Enters the contents of the active cell and moves one cell to the right
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves one cell to the left
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Tab completes cell entry and moves focus one cell to the right.

question: Which shortcut key is used to enter the contents of the active cell and move one cell to the left?
explanation: Shift + Tab completes entry and shifts active selection one cell to the left.

question: What is the function of Ctrl + Z in the active workbook?
options: Cut the current selection to the clipboard
Delete the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Ctrl + Z reverses/undoes the last action.

question: Which shortcut key is used to undo the last action in the active workbook?
explanation: Ctrl + Z undoes the most recent action.

question: What is the function of Ctrl + Y in the active workbook?
options: Cut the current selection to the clipboard
Delete the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Ctrl + Y redoes or repeats the last command.

question: Which shortcut key is used to display the Pick From List drop-down list in the active cell?
explanation: Alt + Down Arrow opens the drop-down list of unique values in the current column.

question: What is the function of Shift + Delete in the active cell?
options: Cuts the selection to the clipboard
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
explanation: Shift + Delete acts as a legacy cut command to place selection on the clipboard.

question: Which shortcut key is used to enter the current time into the active cell?
explanation: Ctrl + Shift + ; enters the current time into the selected cell.

question: Which shortcut key is used to display the Insert dialog box for inserting cells?
explanation: Ctrl + Shift + = opens the Insert dialog box.

question: What is the function of Alt + Enter in the active cell?
options: Enters a new line into a cell
Enters the contents of the active cell and moves to the cell above
Deletes the selection or one character to the right
explanation: Alt + Enter adds line breaks within an individual cell.

question: Which shortcut key is used to delete text to the end of the line?
explanation: Ctrl + Delete deletes text from the insertion point to the end of the line.
